2. Reason: The Planner in Step 9 contains a critical factual error. It incorrectly interprets the Wikipedia text stating that Columbia extends into neighboring counties (Lexington and Kershaw) as evidence that Columbia is the "county seat of Lexington County." The text explicitly states earlier in the same paragraph that Columbia is the county seat of **Richland County**. This misinterpretation leads to an incorrect final answer (Lexington County instead of Richland County) and wastes a step verifying the wrong information.
